title: Silhouettes na Afirka, alamomin samarwa da ƙima

say: Silhouettes na Afirka, alamomin samarwa, da ƙima.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfura huɗu na Advanced Tailoring and Pattern Yin.
Za ka zana iro da buba, kaftan da boubous, da lissafin masana'anta kafin ka saya.

panel.heading: Daga tufa ɗaya zuwa cikakken tsari

say: Sa'an nan kuma ku juya samfurin da aka gwada ɗaya zuwa saitin samarwa, tare da alamomi waɗanda ke adana masana'anta, kuma ku ƙididdige shi a girman girman.

say: Kimono-yanke buba shine T-siffa, tare da yanke hannun riga a daya tare da jiki. Misali, Yetunde a cikin Abeokuta ya zayyana wa abokin ciniki mai tsayin stimita 104. Ta zaɓi 20 cm cikin sauƙi, don haka kowane kwata yana da 31 cm a matakin bust.

panel.heading: Yetunde ya zayyana buba da iro
items: Bust 104 + 20 sauƙi, ÷ 4 = 31 cm kwata
Duban hip: (112 + 8) ÷ 4 = 30 cm, da kyau
Matsakaicin hannun riga: 10 cm tsayi mai tsayi
Iro: 4 cm kugu, 25 cm ta gaba
Kugiya da sanduna don haka ya tsaya don rawa

say: Ta duba kwatangwalo: 112 da 8, raba ta 4, yana buƙatar 30 cm. Layin gefenta na 31 cm ya isa, don haka kabu na gefen yana gudana kai tsaye.
